name: drive-download-file
description: Download a file from Google Drive to temporary storage and return a file:// URL for use with email-send or email-reply attachments. Accepts a Drive file ID or any drive.google.com / docs.google.com URL. Google Docs/Sheets/Slides are exported to PDF by default; pass export_mime_type to override. Pass the returned temp_file_url in the attachments array of email-send or email-reply.

inputs.file_id_or_url: string (Google Drive file ID or full Drive URL — drive.google.com/file/d/<id>/..., drive.google.com/open?id=<id>, drive.google.com/uc?id=<id>, docs.google.com/document/d/<id>/..., docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<id>/..., docs.google.com/presentation/d/<id>/...)
inputs.filename: string? (filename hint for the output. Falls back to the name from Drive metadata.)
inputs.export_mime_type: string? (for Google-native formats — Docs/Sheets/Slides — the MIME type to export to. Defaults to application/pdf. Use application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document for DOCX from a Google Doc.)

outputs.temp_file_url: string (file:// URL of the downloaded bytes on disk — pass this as file_url in the attachments array of email-send or email-reply)
outputs.filename: string (filename of the downloaded file, with appropriate extension)
outputs.content_type: string (MIME type of the downloaded/exported content)
